requirement.description: The main_module_path can be None, but is being passed to subprocess without proper validation, causing TypeError when the subprocess tries to interpret None as an integer.
requirement.contract: When initializing a worker process, if main_module_path is None, it should be handled gracefully instead of being passed directly to subprocess initialization.

requirement.description: The main_module_path is being pickled and sent to worker processes, but when it's None or contains invalid paths, it causes failures in the worker process initialization.
requirement.contract: When sending the main_module_path to worker processes via pickle, ensure that None values or invalid paths are handled properly without causing worker process startup failures.

requirement.description: Socket operations are failing due to 'embedded null byte in path' errors, likely caused by improper handling of path strings that contain null bytes in abstract Unix domain socket paths.
requirement.contract: Socket path validation and handling must properly sanitize paths to prevent null bytes from being passed to the underlying OS socket APIs.
